consequences: Full provider-attempt, background-job and Host-to-paint correlation remain separate acceptance work. Tests and UI fixture screenshots are not real-provider or release evidence.
context: Legacy REPL durations and desktop event timestamps do not prove contiguous phase spans or completion of independent workers.
decision: Collect content-free monotonic spans at actual runtime, recall, signal and post-turn consumer calls. Keep legacy durations and delivery instants separate; final unclosed work is end_unobserved. Project allowlisted decision rules without prompts or model reasons.
title: Execution evidence is distinct from delivery events and background completion
